sam: FYI nightly-eval (2026-03-19T02:15Z) flagged a quality regression on the finance-faq promptset after onboarding 'mistral-3b-ptqv2'. Hallucination rate +6.8% vs float baseline; failures concentrated on numeric/structured answers (acct numbers, APRs).

linh: Can you paste the eval snippet and the model+quant config? Any other infra changes overnight?

sam: Eval excerpt:
```
baseline (mistral-3b-fp32): factuality 98.7%, hallucination 0.9%
canary  (mistral-3b-ptqv2): factuality 92.1%, hallucination 7.7%
delta: hallucination +6.8pp
failing examples ~ 142/210 (numeric/structured)
```
Model config: PTQ per-channel symmetric, 8-bit, calibration run on 'default-calib-v1' (no numeric-heavy augmentation). Tokenizer version unchanged (v4.2.1).

diego: I repro locally with the same quant artifact + tokenizer. The generator often emits early </s> or truncates right after colon/long digit sequences. Quick repro command:
```
./tools/run_eval --model models/mistral-3b-ptqv2 --prompts datasets/finance-faq/seed1.jsonl --num_samples 200
```

maya: I traced logits for a few failing examples. At decode step ~6 the stop-token logit jumps abnormally when the next token is a long numeric token (e.g., "123456789012"). The same prompts on fp32 don't show the spike.

sam: here's a small diff of pre-softmax logits (fp32 vs ptq):
```
fp32:  ... -1.2, -0.9, -0.7, 0.02, 0.1, 0.3 ...
ptq :  ... -1.2, -0.9, -0.7, 0.05, 5.2, 10.1 ...  <-- stop-token spike
```

diego: hypothesis: PTQ calibration did not include numeric-heavy tokens; per-channel scale folding in the first attention block introduced a small bias for embeddings that represent long digit sequences. That bias amplifies in early layers and surfaces as a stop-token spike after softmax.

linh: actionable mitigations?

maya: immediate mitigation: rollback hosted API routes using mistral-3b-ptqv2 to the fp32 variant. Also gate the model in Dedicated until we confirm PTQ fix.

sam: I'll open a rollback request now. deploy-bot: start canary rollback for routes `finance-*` on mistral-3b-ptqv2.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback initiated: 2% traffic -> fp32, monitor window 6h, auto-rollback threshold: hallucination delta > 1.5pp (nightly eval). Ticket: INF-2345

diego: longer-term fix: augment PTQ calibration set with numeric-heavy synthetic examples (account numbers, long decimals, colon/ISO timestamps), re-run calibration and validate with a numeric-preservation unit test.

maya: add an onboarding gating rule in CI: synthetic numeric test that asserts token-level identity for long digit runs and EM on structured answers >= 99% compared to fp32. If test fails, block release.

linh: canary config suggestion (redwood canary DSL):
```
canary:
  traffic: 0.02
  duration: 6h
  metrics:
    - name: hallucination_rate
      threshold_delta: 0.015
      compare_to: baseline_fp32
  auto_action: rollback
```

sam: created INF-2345 (PTQ numeric bias). Assigned to diego. Tasks:
- diego: add numeric augmentation & re-run PTQ (48h)
- maya: implement numeric-preservation CI test + add to onboarding pipeline (72h)
- linh: hold Dedicated/private onboarding for this artifact until green (IMMEDIATE)
- sam: monitor nightly evals & update stakeholders (done)

diego: I'll also instrument a lightweight per-token log during calibration to catch large stop-token deltas.

maya: after fix, we should run a targeted regression suite: finance-faq + billing-forms + structured-qa across multiple seeds and tokenizers.

sam: thanks all. We'll treat this as P1 for onboarding cadence. Follow-ups in INF-2345, I'll update the runbook with the new gating step.

linh: :thumbsup: keep updates in the ticket thread. Closing slack triage for now.
